sloka: अयोध्यां विजनां कृत्वा राघवो भरतस्तथा ।स्वर्गस्य गमनोद्योगं कृतवन्तौ महारथौ ।। ७.१०८.५ ॥
transliteration: ayodhyāṁ vijanāṁ kṛtvā rāghavo bharatastathā ।svargasya gamanodyogaṁ kṛtavantau mahārathau ।। 7.108.5 ॥

translations.english: Having rendered Ayodhya deserted, Rama and Bharata, the two great warriors, prepared for their journey to heaven.
